items.title: Allan Vaché interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: I was listening to Charlie Parker records and my father hated it.

ctx.x: I see. Look what they’ve done to my song, right? That’s funny. You know most teenagers, their rebellion is Steppenwolf or something.
Exactly. That’s what all my friends, that’s what they listened to, you know, and their parents hated it. I was listening to Charlie Parker records and my father hated it.
But you eventually — correct me if I’m wrong, please — but your tastes maybe worked backwards again?
